page.overview:
Who is Konbu?

Konbu is a child who lived in Punk Hazard's Biscuits Room. He was freed with the rest of the children by the Straw Hat Pirates.

Konbu is a young boy with dark hair and no neck. Due to Caesar Clown's experiments, he is larger than normal children.

Despite being a very caring and friendly child, Konbu turned hostile while going through withdrawal symptoms from Caesar's drugs.

After tasting Sanji's cooking, he has developed an interest in becoming a chef himself.
